'''Hali''' was a temperate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] with three [[Star/Legends|suns]] and at least two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Marit Dice]].
